card: The instrument hash misses what a run reads: platform rules, prep, knobs
guard_cases: inside the_resolved_judge_tier test: haiku core and sonnet core (both judged by opus) keep one instrument_hash; base_hash identical across core tiers
inside case 6: old tournament dir and its instrument.json byte-unchanged after the new plan
deviations_from_card: Revision applied: case 6 asserts a new tournament_id, every run New, old dir byte-unchanged. Policy path is derived inside instrument::compute by the <character>/../../policy convention (no policy_rules input field). instrument_for gained a core_tier parameter so the per-run hash carries the resolved judge tier (None with judging off; a judge-tier misconfiguration now fails at plan, before spend). Platforms are sorted before joining. SIM_LOGIC_VERSION not bumped (stays shadowrunr-sim/11). Two existing assertions moved as a direct consequence: PRE_BRIEF_HASH golden (the always-present `absent` rules entry) and instrument_change_gives_separate_results now expects 2 instrument hashes (one per judge tier) instead of 1. Tests and impl landed in one commit because the tests live in the same source files.
notes: Architecture gate: every existing base hash changes once; in-progress tournaments restart in a new <matrix>-<base10> folder; no run dir or instrument.json is rewritten or deleted. Live sink stays out of the hash (existing a_live_sink_changes_neither_the_transcript_nor_the_instrument still green). First cargo test attempt hit sibling engine-llm-sessions in-flight (crate::ladder unresolved in shadowrunr-engine); green on re-run after 60s.
